home.metaTitle: Unity — Rent What You Need. Earn From What You Have.
home.metaDescription: South Africa's peer-to-peer rental marketplace. Identity-reviewed users and test-mode checkout.

hero.description: Unity connects South Africans to rent and lend safely — reviewed users, secure checkout.

home.marquee: CAMERAS • CAMPING • POWER TOOLS • DRONES • BICYCLES • AUDIO GEAR • LIGHTING • PROJECTORS • SPORTS • GARDEN • EVENTS • VEHICLES •

howItWorks.heading: THREE STEPS.
howItWorks.browseBookDesc: Find what you need, pick your dates, and pay securely through Unity's checkout.
howItWorks.meetRentDesc: Collect or receive the item from a reviewed local owner and start using it.
howItWorks.returnReviewDesc: Hand it back in good shape, get your deposit released, and leave an honest review.

platformFeatures.heading: FOUR WAYS TO USE UNITY.
platformFeatures.rentalHeading: BROWSE AND BOOK ITEMS NEAR YOU.
platformFeatures.rentalDesc: Rent cameras, tools, camping gear and more from reviewed local owners — pick your dates and check out securely.
platformFeatures.rentalImageAlt: Screenshot of the Unity rental listings browse page
platformFeatures.buySellDesc: Buy and sell items outright, alongside renting — using the same trusted, identity-reviewed community and secure test-mode checkout.
platformFeatures.barterDesc: Swap what you have for what you need — no cash required. More details on how bartering will work are coming soon.
platformFeatures.ambassadorDesc: Share your referral link and earn commission every time someone you refer completes a rental.
platformFeatures.ambassadorImageAlt: Screenshot of the Unity Ambassador Program page
